# DSCodex

> Open-source multi-model router for OpenAI Codex that runs only on the user's machine. It adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to the stock ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI, and Codex IDE extension, and keeps GPT models on ChatGPT OAuth. DeepSeek traffic uses the native Responses API. No fork, no app patch.

- Canonical repository: https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex
- Latest release: v1.2.0 "From the New World" (2026-09-11) — https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.2.0
- License: MIT
- Runtime: Node.js >= 24.5, zero npm runtime dependencies
- Default loopback: `http://127.0.0.1:10110/<router-token>/v1`

## What it is

DSCodex writes two marker-owned keys into `~/.codex/config.toml`:

1. `openai_base_url` — the token-authenticated loopback router
2. `model_catalog_json` — a merged catalog that inserts `🐳 DeepSeek Flash` into the native picker

Traffic splits by model name. `deepseek/deepseek-flash` (and the legacy names `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) go to `https://api.deepseek.com/responses`. Every other model, including GPT, is forwarded to `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex` with the original OAuth headers.

It is not a plugin for chatgpt.com. Pets, plugins, skills, and MCP stay client-side. Voice / GPT-Live is never sent to DeepSeek.

## What it is not

| Name | Relationship |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek official Codex setup | Replaces the whole Codex provider with a DeepSeek API key; GPT OAuth models leave the picker. Use DSCodex when both must stay. |
| DSCode (thinkany-ai/dscode) | A separate multi-provider coding agent. Different codebase, different product. |
| DeepCodex and similar names | Independent projects. Do not treat them as this repository. |
| skychentian/codex-deepseek-router | A community fork that once tracked an older DSCodex. The canonical source is fish2lab/DSCodex. |

## Install (coding agents)

Never print or commit the DeepSeek API key.

```bash
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... node src/cli.mjs key set
node src/cli.mjs install
node src/cli.mjs start
node src/cli.mjs doctor    # config, catalog, router token, proxy, key, bridge must all be ok
```

Then fully quit (⌘Q) the ChatGPT desktop app, relaunch, start a **new** task, and pick `🐳 DeepSeek Flash`. Existing tasks keep their old model state.

Full constraints: https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Capabilities

- Native DeepSeek tool loops: shell, apply_patch, function calls, web search
- Native vision: `input_image` parts are forwarded to `deepseek-flash`; no GPT image descriptions
- Remote compaction v2 for DeepSeek: the summary is encrypted into a DSCodex compaction item, never stored as plaintext in the rollout
- GPT passthrough stays byte-for-byte unless foreign DeepSeek `reasoning_text` or an undecryptable DSCodex compaction item must be stripped
- Optional macOS app-server bridge for per-provider effort memory in the picker; off by default because it moves the app onto stdio and breaks Computer Use
- Optional autostart: launchd / systemd / Windows Task Scheduler. Generated artifacts never embed the API key.

## Reasoning effort

The hosted DeepSeek Responses API accepts only the string levels `none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max`. Integer Juice 1–100 and `ultra` return HTTP 400.

The DSCodex catalog exposes two Codex slider stops and the router folds every incoming level into them:

| Codex slider | Sent to DeepSeek | Model Juice (HF encoding) |
|---|---|---|
| High | `high` | 75 |
| Max (picker default) | `max` | 100 |

Fold rule: `low` / `medium` / `high` → `high`; anything else, including `xhigh`, `max`, `ultra`, → `max`. DeepSeek itself collapses Codex's six levels into three (`minimal`/`low` → 50, `medium`/`high`/`xhigh` → 75, `max`/`ultra` → 100), so exposing more stops would add no resolution.

## FAQ

Q: Can I use DeepSeek and GPT in the same Codex / ChatGPT desktop app?
A: Yes. The picker keeps GPT and adds `🐳 DeepSeek Flash`. The router selects the backend by model name.

Q: Does the official DeepSeek Codex script do the same thing?
A: No. It points all of Codex at DeepSeek and drops the GPT OAuth models.

Q: Does DSCodex modify the ChatGPT or Codex binaries?
A: No. It owns only `openai_base_url`, `model_catalog_json`, and the `~/.codex/dscodex/` directory.

Q: Which DeepSeek model is in the picker after v1.2.0?
A: One entry, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, wire name `deepseek-flash`. Legacy Flash / Pro names still route there.

Q: Windows?
A: Codex CLI and IDE routing work on Windows. The optional app-server bridge is macOS-only.
